title: Roveia sector list (v2)
description: A quiet 32px label over a numbered list of very large (80px) sector names in regular weight, each with a tiny index; names turn brand blue on hover. On phones the sectors become dark cards with a blue glow from the top-left, an illustration slot, a paragraph and a row of client wordmarks. Rows fade and rise in as they enter.
notes: the phone cards wrap themselves in .dark, so they stay dark in a light theme
descriptions, clients and media only show on the phone cards, like the original
name: roveia-v2-industries
